visual_thesis: Business definitions and document access solve different answer failures. At phone scale see two distinct knowledge routes sharing tables; full size shows certified definitions, scope, document retrieval and end-to-end checking without promising universal accuracy.
mechanism_metaphor: One architectural cross-section of a branching knowledge bridge, drawn as a sparse precise copper engraving rather than blocks or panels. A broad shared data foundation at bottom-left exposes distinct policy, claim and reserve table strata with blank unnumbered cells, not text strokes. An upper bridge carries a certified calculation plate, domain boundary and explanatory page, with headless association leaders showing their mutual support. A lower bridge carries a curated-agent instruction fold and document-search channel ending in a distinct PDF-shaped folded specimen. Both converge at one answer junction at right. Exactly two directed arrowheads: business-definition bridge physical port to the answer join, and document-context bridge physical port to the same join. Below right an end-to-end test specimen sits next to the answer, linked only by a headless comparison bracket. A detached local-rules note under the document route explains maintenance without a feedback loop. At least fourteen useful components: common table bed, three scoped data strata, metric plate, domain boundary, explanatory page, curation fold, search channel, document specimen, two routed knowledge spans, answer join and end-to-end comparison. No numeric success badges, shields, simulated writing, percentage bars or automatic certainty.
